resources.string: Hex RU uses the internet to download its speech models. Your voice and words stay on this device.
Allow the microphone, then choose Hex RU as your keyboard.
So Hex RU can hear you
Choose Hex RU in the list
Turn on Hex RU in Settings
Hex RU turns speech into text on this phone. It keeps no keystrokes or transcripts and never uploads your voice or what you type. The app connects to the internet to download speech models.
